Package view.abstraction

Interface CursoredCanvas

All Known Implementing Classes:
CompositeCanvas, DisplayCanvas
public interface CursoredCanvas
A canvas with a cursor that can be filled with a Described object and repainted.

  • Method Details

    • fillCursor

      void fillCursor(Described formal, Described erased, boolean paint)
      Fill this canvas's cursor and if demanded paints it's content. It also sets objects needed for erasing.
      Parameters:
      formal - The described primitive that should be displayed by the cursor.
      erased - The previously displayed but now removed described primitive. May be null.
      paint - Wether to actually paint or just calculate new layout values.
